name: Savannah Santa Train
venue: Georgia State Railroad Museum and Savannah Children's Museum
when_note: Open from 10 am to 3 pm, with timed train departures.
ages: All ages (ages 18 months and up need a ticket)
paras: The Coastal Heritage Society runs its annual Savannah Santa Train on Saturday, December 12, 2026, across the Georgia State Railroad Museum and the Savannah Children's Museum. Tickets cost $21 for the public and $18 for CHS members.

The day includes historic train and handcar rides, photos with Santa, live entertainment, holiday crafts and interactive activities that mark Christmas, Hanukkah and Kwanzaa. Everyone 18 months and older needs a ticket, so reserve a train departure time early.
tip: Reserve your departure time online before the day, since train rides are timed.

name: Savannah Lighted Boat Parade
venue: Savannah River, viewable from Eastern Wharf, Rousakis Riverfront Plaza and River Street
when_note: The boats glide down the river from 7 to 9 pm.
paras: The 25th Annual Savannah Lighted Boat Parade sends more than 30 boats, decked in thousands of lights, down the Savannah River on Saturday, November 28, 2026, from 7 to 9 pm. The boats cruise between Eastern Wharf and the Talmadge Bridge.
You can watch from Eastern Wharf, Rousakis Riverfront Plaza, River Street or Plant Riverside District. Visit Savannah suggests arriving early to claim a spot along the riverwall.
tip: Arrive early for a riverwall spot, since the viewing areas fill up before 7 pm.
